coverage: Read native schematic and PCB; verified component identities, pin/net assignments and saved population flags.
Fresh KiCad 10.0.7 netlist export matches supplied component population and connectivity.
Calculated fitted-resistor connectivity and R1 pad separation.
Inspected supplied ERC, DRC, netlist and geometry reports and execution records. ERC/DRC report zero native violations; these results do not establish assembled electrical conduction.

findings.condition: Assembly follows the saved population, with no alternate assembly override.

evidence.locator: Line 1: requires a fitted resistive DC path from /IN to /OUT
Lines 1252–1285: Device:R instance R1, value 10k, has (dnp yes)
Line 304: (attr smd dnp); lines 359–374: separate R1 pads assigned /IN and /OUT
Lines 138–154: only resistor is DNP; fitted_resistor_edges is empty; fitted_resistive_path_IN_to_OUT is false; pad gap is 0.8 mm

findings.mechanism: The only resistor connecting the two nets is excluded from assembly. Its separate PCB pads and terminating tracks do not conduct across the absent component.
findings.reasoning: Both native files mark R1 DNP, corroborated by the supplied and freshly exported netlists. The remaining fitted parts are connector J1 and capacitor C1 from /OUT to GND; neither supplies the missing resistive connection. The saved assembly therefore fails the stated DC-path requirement, despite clean ERC and DRC results.
findings.title: DNP R1 removes the required fitted resistive path

limitations: No physical assembly measurements or SPICE simulation performed; the finding follows directly from saved population and topology.
Voltage, load, ratings, tolerances, startup, shutdown, reset, brownout and interface behavior were not evaluated because corresponding operating conditions are unspecified.
ERC/DRC were inspected rather than rerun; their listed ignored checks remain untested. Saved zone fill was not regenerated, and no comprehensive independent clearance audit was performed.
Geometry extraction emitted PROPERTY_ENUM assertions. Relevant population and pad data were independently corroborated from native files.
Commands, versions, assumptions, calculations and outcomes are recorded in review-work/circuit/experiments/check_population.py, commands.json, supplied_check_records.json and notes.md.
